in_scope: React + TypeScript + Vite Brainstorm Web Host Frontend MVP
typed API boundary and development-only mock adapter
browser interaction, accessibility, responsive, and security acceptance
non_goals: 本轮不修改 P0–P6 Governor runtime、锁定决定或合法状态语义
本轮不实现或宣称真实后端编排、真实 Provider 调用和生产身份系统
本轮不部署、不配置 DNS、不保存真实凭据、不 push、不 merge 或创建 PR

components.responsibility: Define the frozen frontend domain and API contracts.
Provide the typed host boundary and development-only mock adapter.
Own the versioned allowlisted browser session projection.
Render and coordinate intake, framing, run, capability, human-gate, and handoff flows.
Compose the application shell, navigation, and top-level session lifecycle.

decisions.decision: Use React, TypeScript, Vite, and npm.
decisions.rationale: The repository has no existing frontend stack and the approved host is a browser application.

decisions.decision: Hide runtime behavior behind a typed BrainstormApi and show a visible development-mock indicator.
decisions.rationale: The frontend must be locally runnable without implying that a real backend or Provider integration exists.

decisions.decision: Persist only a versioned, allowlisted, non-secret session projection in sessionStorage.
decisions.rationale: Refresh recovery is required while credentials and other sensitive transient values must never be persisted.

decisions.decision: Use React context and local state without a large state-management dependency.
decisions.rationale: The MVP has one bounded session flow and does not justify another runtime dependency.

tasks.title: Bootstrap toolchain, contracts, mappings, and persistence
Implement application shell, idea intake, and six-frame wizard
Implement mock API, run, capability, human gate, and handoff flows
Complete responsive visual system and accessibility behavior
Run browser E2E, reviews, and package acceptance evidence

acceptance.criterion: 标准跳过路径、NEEDS_INPUT 恢复、Council 双 Provider 授权、Provider 失败和刷新恢复均可在浏览器完成；typecheck、lint、行为测试、production build、E2E、无障碍、React 与安全审查全部通过
终端用户无需查看或编辑 Governor JSON 即可完成 Idea Intake 和六 Frame Wizard。
四种 Idea stage 选择分别且仅映射到 Shape、Spark、Stress、Decide。
六 Frame 映射到约定 canonical 字段，并保留 UNKNOWN、ASSUMPTION、KNOWN、CONFLICT 知识分类；AI 建议不得自动成为 KNOWN。
运行页表达完整阶段、Governor 合法状态，并允许 NEEDS_INPUT 在同一 session lineage 中补充信息后恢复。
External Capability Gate 支持 Council Enable/Skip、至少两个独立 Provider 的校验和调用前显式授权。
API key 仅存在于 capability screen 的临时组件状态，不进入持久化、URL、日志、telemetry、manifest、Living Brief、Trace 或真实测试 fixture。
Human Gate 支持 Confirm、Request iteration 和 Provide missing input，且只有 Governor COMMIT 才显示正式 Final Handoff。
标准跳过、NEEDS_INPUT、Council、Provider failure 和刷新恢复场景均通过行为测试与真实浏览器 E2E。
390、768、1280、1440 代表性视口、键盘导航、焦点、标签、错误关联、对比度和 reduced motion 完成验证。
前端 typecheck、lint、单元与集成测试、production build、React review、UI review、安全审查、P7 validator 和 P0–P6 regression 全部通过。

gate.summary: Independent Brainstorm Web Host contract is pinned; frontend implementation is in progress.
